results.manual_evidence: Donation was selected, SAVE was executed, and the form exited before completion.
The exact file was selected, Ringtones was chosen, MOVE was executed, and the native evaluator confirmed the mutation.

evidence: The bottom MOVE commit executed once and the native evaluator returned reward 1.0.
The M0 completion Critic rejected immediate completion because the destination was not yet visibly verified.
The sole repair proposed wait on the stale source/search view.
The post-destination guard correctly rejected wait, but the completion-rejection repair prompt had not constrained the repair to reversible navigation.
root_cause.interpretation: The task mutation succeeded; the protocol failed only because two individually correct safety rules were not composed in the same bounded repair.

r39_policy: When completion is rejected after a bottom Copy/Move commit is already active, the sole repair must be status=continue with the exact press_back action.
This leaves the stale source/search or transfer UI without waiting, repeating the mutation, exposing coordinates, or rewriting the model action.
The next observed policy steps may use reversible navigation to verify the requested destination.
